postconditions.description: The input string S has a length exactly equal to N.

postconditions.expression: any(S.count(substring) >= 2 for substring in substrings) and not any(S.count(substring) == 1 for substring in substrings)
postconditions.description: There exists at least one substring in substrings that appears at least twice in S.

postconditions.expression: all(substring not in S[i+1:] for i, substring in enumerate(S) for substrings in [S[j:] for j in range(len(S)) if j > i])
postconditions.description: No substring in substrings overlaps with any other substring in the string S.

postconditions.expression: max(len(substring) for substring in substrings) == max(len(substring) for substring in substrings if S.count(substring) >= 2)
postconditions.description: The length of the longest non-overlapping substring is the maximum length among those substrings that appear at least twice.
